6:: `gene1` contains the gene which makes up the 5' end of the transcript and `gene2` the gene which makes up the 3' end. The order is predicted on the basis of the strands that the supporting reads map to, how the reads are oriented, and splice patterns. Both columns may contain the same gene if the event is intragenic. If a breakpoint is in an intergenic region, Arriba lists the closest genes upstream and downstream from the breakpoint, separated by a comma.
